clock_caveat: Host RTC is not synchronised (no NTP source). The absolute time carries an unquantified offset. The binding claim is the ordering: this plan was written before any external probability array, binary mask or metric existed.

cohorts.reason: The HAM10000 folder is the ISIC-2018 Task 3 classification release, which ships no segmentation masks. 10,015 mask files exist with no recorded provenance, so Dice against them would not measure the model. No inference is run and the previously quoted 79.15% is not citable.

exclusion_rule: Row included iff evaluable == True in the frozen manifest AND image_path resolves AND the ground-truth reference resolves AND the mask rasterises. Applied mechanically; no post-hoc row drops.
prior_consultation_disclosure: All three included cohorts were previously used to build the ext02 manifests and to classify evidence provenance, and a figure pilot previously ran the global model on 8 hand-picked single cases using a NON-CANONICAL plain 512x512 stretch resize. Those pilot numbers are superseded and are not pooled with this study. No checkpoint, threshold, seed or preprocessing choice was selected on the basis of external aggregate performance.

frozen_identities.refiner_note: The _roi030 refiner variant is used, matching the Phase 29 seed-42 binding. phase25a_barr_regional_refiner_v1_1 is a different artefact and is NOT used.

preprocessing.image: RGB -> aspect-preserving bilinear resize (scale=min(512/W,512/H)) -> centre on 512x512 canvas with zero pad -> /255
preprocessing.ground_truth: same geometry, NEAREST resize, same pad, binarise > 0
preprocessing.coco_rasterisation: rasterise polygons at NATIVE resolution first, then apply the geometry
preprocessing.superseded_convention: A plain 512x512 stretch resize was used by an earlier figure pilot. It is NOT used here; stress-test numbers and figures both use the aspect-preserving convention.

barr.justification: A frozen end-to-end composition exists at scripts/analysis/phase29_phase_d_canonical_seed_inference.py. The 202-D router features come from src/features/barr_pre_refinement_features.py reading three Global MedFiLM taps via read-only forward hooks; the 16-D safety features come from scripts/analysis/phase25f_post_safety_features.py. Both class-defining sources still hash-match their Phase 29 bindings. All four checkpoints hash-match.
barr.driver_note: The Phase 29 driver is hard-wired to VAL808 and its precomputed cache. The external run uses a new driver that supplies only the population and per-case bookkeeping; every frozen component and feature extractor is reused verbatim. This distinction must be stated whenever BARR external results are reported.
barr.router_normalisation: Only the 8 frozen scalar indices are standardised, using the checkpoint's own normalizer_mu/sigma/constant_mask. The 192 deep features are passed raw. This reproduces the Phase 29 convention.
barr.state_note: ROUTED and EXECUTED are staged, not terminal. The terminal state of a selected case is ACCEPTED, REJECTED, FALLBACK_TO_GLOBAL or FAILED. Stage counts and terminal counts must both be reported.
barr.abort_condition: Any component hash mismatch, any strict state-dict failure, or any disagreement between the two decision forms aborts the run and BARR is reported as BARR_NOT_EXECUTABLE_FROM_VERIFIED_ARTIFACTS.

metrics.surface_units_reason: No external cohort ships physical pixel spacing. Millimetre surface metrics are forbidden. Cross-cohort surface-metric comparison is prohibited; only within-cohort Global vs BARR comparison is permitted.
metrics.degenerate_policy: Degenerate GT and degenerate prediction cases are kept and scored. Undefined metrics are NaN with a recorded reason; NaN is never replaced by 0 and never silently dropped.
metrics.aggregation: Primary = per-cohort macro mean over cases (equal case weight). Pooled pixel-level aggregation is secondary and must be labelled as such.

statistics.labelling: descriptive interval under a stated resampling scheme

figures.case_selection_rule: Per cohort: median-Dice case, worst case, best case; for Stones also the largest and smallest ground-truth lesion. Degenerate cases must be labelled on the panel face.

prohibitions: No training, fine-tuning or parameter update.
No threshold tuning, per-cohort calibration or operating-point selection.
No access to the locked internal TEST split or ROUTER_HOLDOUT.
No fabricated, interpolated or hand-edited predictions.
No change to any C1 trust boundary, approval state or scientific_execution_enabled.
No modification of a frozen component source file.

c1_status.note: This study reads no C1 trust store and provisions no key.
